source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Each player's Primary Mission comes from the Force Disposition cards:

1. In secret, each player picks one Force Disposition card that their muster made available; then both reveal together.
2. On your own card, look up the symbol of your opponent's disposition. The Primary Mission listed under it is yours and sets how you earn VP.

Players who pick the same Force Disposition share a Primary Mission; each card comes in 2 copies so both can hold it.
